Simply Amazing Food
Nov 2025 • Solo
I went for the 1st time last week and had the amazing hanger steak with roasted corn and potatoes. Then I had to have it again yesterday at the old quarter location, but today I had to be fair and try the pizza, but I am a huge salad eater, and got a salad as well. It was so good. Again, I am a huge salad eater and I could have eaten it all day long. The pizza was the bonus. I watched them making the pizzas when I sat at the bar yesterday. Great care is taken. The wait staff suggested I try some honey with my cheese pizza and I have to say, WINNER COMBO. Tomorrow, I might just go and try a few salads. You just can't go wrong with this restaurant.
